edges.notes: UCRT and VCRUNTIME DLLs are Windows user-mode components on the NT kernel with Win32 subsystem.
Hosted MSVC C programs link CRT entry points provided by UCRT/VCRUNTIME-class DLLs per Microsoft documentation.
Clang targeting Windows can link MSVC-compatible CRT layouts when using Windows SDK and MSVC-style linking.
MSVC C++ standard library DLLs (msvcp*.dll) load in the same process and depend on CRT support DLLs.
